answer: Attackers who spin up many identities must fund every bond, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers vote on whether that identity maps to real work. An atlas of verified work history, a nebula of peer attestations, and a forge of bonded stake together make mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
